job.job_description:
We are seeking a skilled Software Developer to join our technology team and contribute to building scalable digital solutions that support climate resilience and environmental impact initiatives

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in backend and frontend development using either Python, PHP, or React

Roles and Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and enhance web applications using Python, PHP, or React

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into efficient technical solutions

Build and integrate APIs for internal systems and third-party tools

Optimize application performance and ensure security, scalability, and maintainability

Assist in designing databases and managing data flow across different systems

Write clean, modular, and well-documented code following best practices

Support deployment processes and assist in testing, debugging, and continuous improvement

Requirements Minimum 2 years of professional experience in software development

Bachelordegree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

Proficiency in at least one of the following: Python, PHP, Node

js, React

Experience with databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL

Familiarity with REST APIs, Git, and cloud deployment (AWS or similar)

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

Benefits Salary Range: 8 to 10 LPA"
